_note: Drafts written by Claude on 2026-11-16 from each place's own website, in our own words. To be read by a person before anything is published.

stays.Grand Hotel Toplice: A lakeside hotel in the centre of Bled, run by Sava Hotels & Resorts. The D2 route passes the front door.
stays.Penzion Kaps: Ten rooms in a quiet part of central Bled, several with a balcony or terrace and one sized for a family.
stays.Hotel Lovec: A boutique hotel in the heart of Bled, on the spot where a guesthouse has stood for over a hundred years. Some rooms look onto the lake, and there is a grill restaurant and a pub.
stays.Garden Village Bled: An eco resort near the lake where you sleep among the treetops, built around time outdoors.
stays.Ribno Luxury Glamping: A family-run resort at the edge of a spruce forest in the village of Ribno, with glamping tents next to a small hotel.
stays.Apartments and Rooms Tavcar: Private apartments and rooms in Zasip, the village next to Bled. Quiet, with open views, and suited to families and couples.

food.Gostilna Pri planincu: A family inn since 1929 serving traditional Slovenian dishes, open every day from noon.
food.Bar in restavracija Špica: One of Bled's longest-running restaurants, on the lakeshore with a view of the island and the castle. Restaurant, pizzeria and bar under one roof, fitted out in rowing style.
food.Arroi Restaurant: An Asian kitchen with Thai food at its centre, plus sushi and cocktails.
food.Steak House Berc: The steakhouse of Penzion Berc, a family house with sixty years behind it. Evenings only.
food.Slaščičarna Zima: A pastry shop for Bled's cream cake, gibanica and homemade ice cream, made fresh each day.
food.Okrepčevalnica Galetovec: A small, homely snack bar in Bohinjska Bela, on the way from Bled towards Bohinj.
